description: Revokes the API key making the call, at once and for good: every later call with it gets 401 revoked_key. Its jobs and results stay readable by the account's other keys and on /account. Works for sandbox and live keys. MCP tools need confirm: true. The same as DELETE /api/v1/key.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

confirm.description: Must be true: revoking can't be undone.

name: revoke_key
title: Revoke this API key
